hero.eyebrow: Trauma-informed psychotherapy · Long Island, New York
hero.heading: A space to heal. The support to grow. The freedom to thrive.
hero.body: At Unleashed Potential Psychotherapy, we believe exceptional mental health care begins with feeling truly seen, heard, and understood. Through personalized evidence-based psychotherapy, we offer a thoughtful and compassionate approach to healing from trauma, rebuilding a sense of safety, and reclaiming the confidence and freedom to move forward in Long Island and online across New York.

image.alt: Sunlit consulting room with a linen armchair and a plant

items.title: Grief & loss

items.title: Life transitions
items.body: Changes in work, family or identity that feel hard to steady.
